categories.title: Easy Worlds
categories.description:
Easy Worlds

This book contains a number of scenarios featuring different game conditions.

The first three offer game goals for cooperative or single players, while the remaining three are preset for melee play of two or more players.

In the easy worlds, not all of the numerous game elements are available, so they are ideal learning ground for novice players.

Version 4.65

categories.title: Hazard
categories.description:
Hazard

This folder contains a science fiction scenario that makes use of the Hazard pack.

Version 4.65

categories.title: Knights
categories.description:
Knights

This book contains a medieval scenario that makes use of the knights object pack.

Version 4.65

categories.title: More Maps
categories.description:
More Maps

This book contains a number of additional static maps.

Game mode, starting conditions, animal life, and weather can be modified using the round options (registered version only).

Version 4.61

categories.title: Missions
categories.description:
Missions

In this book you will find a number of scenarios with individual starting conditions and preset game goals.

You will have to register before playing missions.

Version 4.65

categories.title: Tutorial
categories.description:
Tutorial

These interactive tutorial rounds contain step by step instructions to learn the basics of clonk control.

Every player should complete these scenarios to get to know the countless elements of this game.

Clonk can be played with mouse, keyboard, or a combination of both. Each player may choose a preferred method of control by selecting his entry on the left and clicking 'properties'.

See the help and object descriptions for further details.

Version 4.65

categories.title: Worlds
categories.description:
The Book of Worlds

For each of these worlds additional settings can be selected using the round options.

Game mode, equipment, weather conditions, and natural disasters can freely be modified.

In some of these scenarios the landscape can be dynamically adjusted, others have static maps.

You can save your own scenario settings in separate scenario files.

Access to these worlds is available in the registered version only.

Version 4.65

categories.title: Far Worlds
categories.description:
Far Worlds

Independent clonk peoples with their own customs and architecture live here in the Far Worlds. Over time those clonks have adapted to their specific environment and have developed new tools and structures.

These scenarios offer basic settings for open settlement or melee rounds but can be freely adjusted using scenario properties.

Each scenario contains an individual object pack which can be copied to the working directory (drag 'n' drop) and activated for use in other scenarios.

Version 4.65

scenarios.title: Gold Mine
scenarios.description:
Goldmine

To complete this round mine all available gold and take it to your home base. Start out by collecting and selling loose chunks of gold. From the money you make this way buy flint stones to blast veins of gold.

The Easy Worlds are played by a simplyfied rule set. No material is needed for construction. Machines like the elevator do not require energy. The home base flag cannot be removed.

Only a limited number of structure types can be built and the more advanced weapons such as the Super-Flint, Tera-Flint or Firebomb are not yet available.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Water-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Monsterkill
scenarios.description:
Monsterkill

Start out by creating obstacles that the monsters can't cross to protect yourself. Build walls from loam and dig trap holes in the ground.

Then you can strike back with flint stones.

Always reload lost energy in your home base.

Monsters are the toughest life forms in clonk. They will stand a large number of flint stone hits.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Water-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Settlement
scenarios.description:
Settlement

The goal of every player is to produce 500 points economic score. Points are awarded for selling valuable material such as gold but also for building new structures.

The current score is shown in the player status bar during the game (house symbol). In this scenario construction requires material supply. Rock can be found underground, trees need to be chopped and cut in a sawmill, metal can be bought at the home base.

Also available in this round is the settler clonk.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Water-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Minor Melee
scenarios.description:
Minor Melee

Two to four players can take part in a battle. The only goal is to eliminate all opponent clonks. Any tactic from rock throwing, flinging flints with the catapult to man-to-man-battle is allowed.

If the battle takes longer, each player should think of collecting some resources to have enough money for reinforcements and life energy available.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Water-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Shark Lake
scenarios.description:
Shark Lake

Since the direct way of attack is certainly not the most promising in this scenario, players need to develop new tactics for a successfull raid.

Each player has enough time to strengthen his base buy building new structues.

Check the tutorial rounds for how to control catapult, sail boat, and hot air balloon.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Water-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: The Castle
scenarios.description:
The Dark Castle

At the foot of a steep cliff live the people of a small village for which life could be very peaceful if there wasn't the evil Baron Herx living in his dark castle above.

The opposing players have very different starting conditions in this scenario. The first player controls the people of the village. He has more clonks and more buildings but less money available. The second player has only one clonk but the better strategic position.

Baron Herx may easily start attacking the village from above while the people have to build tunnels and bridges to reach the top of the hill. After a while, however, both players will have to watch their resources and mine for gold to increase funds.

The people of the village may also consider establishing a safer underground base. They can for this purpose take the flag off their original base.

scenarios.title: Research Facility
scenarios.description:
Research Facility

"Planet Zergod B, Sector 332. An unauthorized research facility located in a former mining base. The holding company has abandoned the project after contact was cutoff for unknown reasons."

"Make entry and examine the structure. Our company is interested in any kind of useable research data."

"Make sure you are at a good landing site when calling the shuttle with your radio. And make haste - other companies' units might arrive any time."

This scenario is designed for multiplayer melees, but single players, too, will find lots to discover in the research facility. Data cubes can be taken to orbit using the shuttle and will earn you valuable credits.

The reserach facility scenario requires the HazardPack. Additional operating instructions can be found in the object pack's descriptions.

Most of the weapons require specific ammunition. Some ammo packets need to be unpacked with a dig double click first.

Weapon fire - Throw
Drop - Double stop, then throw
Inventory selection - Special 1
Object information - Special 2

scenarios.title: Castle Dunkelfels
scenarios.description:
Castle Dunkelfels

This scenario demonstrates all objects from the Knights pack. It can be used in single player or melee mode.

The knight clonk knows how to handle sword, shield, spear and axe, as well as bow and arrow. He can pick up a lance and ride into battle on the back of his horse.

Inside the buildings you will find numerous objects from medieval daily life. Prepare meals, bake bread, or manufacture goods and weapons in workshops and the smithy.

Castle as well as camp can be extended using elements from the castle construction kit.

More details on control can be found in the objects' descriptions. To view those, double click on the Knights pack.

scenarios.title: Crystal tower
scenarios.description:
Crystal Tower

A pinnacle from crystal and rock towering over a frozen in acid world.

scenarios.title: Ice Caves
scenarios.description:
Ice Caves

A party of clonks sets out to settle in a system of deep icy caves.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Four Islands
scenarios.description:
Four Islands

Build up your settlement on one of these beautiful islands in the middle of the blue ocean.

scenarios.title: Lava Caves
scenarios.description:
Lava Caves

Even in this fiery environment, surrounded by lava, some clonks try to build an underground village.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Lava Lakes
scenarios.description:
Lava Lakes

This volcanic area is torn apart by deep crevices filled with boiling lava.

scenarios.title: Sand Storm
scenarios.description:
Sand Storm

When the clonks found out about the valuable resources found underneath the sand, they set out to conquer even this dry and barren world.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Sky Islands
scenarios.description:
Sky Islands

High up in the sky a group of small chunks of earth loom above the bottomless.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Valley of Kings
scenarios.description:
Valley of Kings

The two sides of this deep cut valley just wait to be settled.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Canyon Wars
scenarios.description:
Canyon Wars

This popular type of melee from Clonk 3 is not forgotten in Clonk Planet. This time two groups of clonks are placed at the opposite sides of a large canyon.

The cannon tower, which is used in this scenario, can either be used as a direct weapon or as a way of getting clonks in the enemy base.

Note: The first team that loses its captain (marked by a star) has lost the match.

scenarios.title: Frontier
scenarios.description:
Frontier

A single clonk enters impassable territory. He will have to make it across over to an abandoned cabin to start a new settlement from there.

To complete this round, build up a whole city, consisting of at least a big castle, two guard towers and six stone houses.

Be careful with what little resources you can buy at your base. You will have to set up a complete functioning industry for wood and metal to support your major construction sites.

scenarios.title: Funnel Valley
scenarios.description:
Funnel Valley

It is hard to found a settlement in this narrow terrain. But a few clonks will try it anyway.

The players should concentrate on building a bridge over the hole in the middle and organize a good route for the train. Additionally, cannon towers equipped with artillery cannons can act as an alternative to the train.

This round has no goal.

scenarios.title: Up High
scenarios.description:
Very High

Finally it happened, the statue of the skyclonks was found. A long time ago the king of the skyclonks sent this statue to the clonks in the mountains as a sign of peace. But suddenly a terrible meteor rain let the blimps explode  and the statue broke into many pieces and fell down.

Now the feet of the big statue were found. You've built up your base next to them. Build the statue up again! Therefore you'll have to find all parts of the statue and bring them to the ground. Don't worry, they won't break. If they are near the statue, they will be attached automatically.

The problem is the landscape: it is very high and full of floating isles. To the first isles you'll get with loam, later you'll need an balloon and other tools. But perfect knowledge of controlling clonks is necessary to get to  the higher levels.

To make it fair, buildings don't need energy and can be built without material.

The round will be won when the statue is in one piece again.

scenarios.title: The Last Will
scenarios.description:
The Last Will

Scotland, 1037: Jeremy, Samuel and Edward are very despaired since their father, old farmer MacFlury, has fallen very ill. Because of a serious rib fracture he cannot walk without help, and now he lies in his bed and is in pain. Within merely a few days his complexion has turned grey. Unable to help their father, the three brothers stand in front of the bed and watch the old farmer. Suddenly, MacFlury opens his eyes for the last time and utters his last will with a hoarse and weak voice: He wants to be buried in the sea. After having said these words, MacFlury's eyelids shut forever.

Although Scotland is an island, Jeremy, Samuel and Edward have never seen the sea. They do not know which way is the fastest to get to the ocean and they do not know either what will expect them on their journey. The three brothers have been told stories about the sea by wanderers who have found a place to stay over night in MacFlury's farm, and all the wanderers have been very surprised when they have heard that neither Jeremy nor Samuel and Edward have ever been near the coast. But the three brothers decide not to disappoint their father and to respect his last will, and so they start the long and dangerous journey.

The first thing Jeremy, Samuel and Edward decide to do is to visit an old magician living in an old castle who can help them. They put the dead farmer on a barrow in order to transport him more easily. After a hole day of walking, they finally reach a lake. On the other side, the three brothers can see the rough outlines of a castle in the fog, but they do not know how to get there. Swimming across the lake is not a good idea because Jeremy, Samuel and Edward could not take the dead farmer with them. A wooden bridge is needed - but how can they build one?

Some hints: Always read the orders exactly. And remember that it is not necessary to take the barrow with the dead farmer with you all the time. It is also possible to proceed exploring the landscape first. After you have reached the sea and created a passable path, you can walk back and transport the dead farmer to the sea. Never try to sell the barrow with the dead farmer! Once it is sold, the barrow cannot be rebought!

scenarios.title: Pearls
scenarios.description:
Pearls

Your objective is to retrieve all the shells with pearls from the bottom of the lagoon and sell them at your base.

Soon you will find it hard to do this by mere diving. You will have to construct tunnels to access the water at deeper points.

scenarios.title: Rattlesnake Canyon
scenarios.description:
Rattlesnake Canyon

Ambitious pioneer clonks have got news of a large occurence of gold at the far end of the country. They have established a small camp and now need to create a road across canyons and mountaineous area.

To place a wooden trestle, carefully push it to the very edge of a canyon and lock it in place with a 'dig' double click. Build new bridge segments in your workshop.

Soon the distance from camp to construction site will become so great that you will want to use the train to move more quickly.

When there is a steam engine connected to a wagon, you can control the train from inside the wagon with 'left' or 'right'.

Landscape.Layers: Gold=5;

scenarios.title: Regeneration
scenarios.description:
Regeneration

Many years ago this country was devastated by an acid rain. Now, you think, is the time has come to build up a village in this strange, forsaken land before another clan does it. Build up a village to show that you are the rightful owner of this land.

The goal is to earn 2500 points.

scenarios.title: Rocks of Thunder
scenarios.description:
Rocks of Thunder

Watch out! This round is a dangerous one. The valley near the Mount Deadly is not a very secure surrounding. Actually, it is one of the most dangerous in the whole world of Clonk.

Does it really matter? No. Ore got extremely rare, so you and your clonks have been sent out to get the last.

The critical point is mainly the energy; power plants need material, wind mills do not work underearth and usually get hit by rocks very easy.

This round will be won if all ore is sold. Therefore you will probably want to build a settlement in the unterground.

scenarios.title: Submarine
scenarios.description:
Submarine

The first clonks have developed new technology needed to access suboceanic resources.

Hint: Lower an elevator case with a lorry into a large water basin and unload from the submarine directly into the lorry.

Landscape.Layers: Gold=5;

scenarios.title: Thieves!
scenarios.description:
Thieves!

The clans Rustuff and McClomby are arguing for over twenty years now. Both want the land around Trudu River. Many clonks, young and old, had to die for this.

Now the found a better way to solve the conflict - they are making a competition. The team, which sells the enemy's flag, wins. There are no further rules, just get their flag.

The goal is to kill all enemies, or sell the flag, which is probably easier.
This round is only suitable for two players.

scenarios.title: The Treasure
scenarios.description:
The Treasure

In the Sand Desert, next to the Snake-River, lies a treasure of immense value. The holy three skulls of the desert clonks, which are very important artefacts.

Now a group of archeologists wants to seize this treasure. But beware: the desert is hot and full of hazards.

Your mission is to find and sell the three holy skulls.

scenarios.title: Skyland Village
scenarios.description:
Skyland Village

This round's goal is building a complete village, consisting of one big castle, three towers and four stone huts.

This is not an easy thing, because the islands are chaotically small in this round. Don't fall. You could get hurt.

scenarios.title: A Clonk
scenarios.description:
A Clonk

This round demonstrates basic clonk control: run, stop, jump, dig.

Using the flag, you can turn a cabin into your home base where you can reload life energy and sell gold.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: More Clonks
scenarios.description:
More Clonks

This round can only be completed through teamwork of several clonks.

To construct an elevator to your home base, construction material needs to be flung across a valley from different positions using catapults.

Once completed, all clonks can reach the home base using the elevator.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Air Travel
scenarios.description:
Air Travel

The flag needed for the home base can be reached by travelling from one sky island to another using the hot air balloon.

Then build bridges from loam chunks to get back to your cabin.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Production Line
scenarios.description:
Production Line

Trees can be chopped down and cut to wood in the sawmill. Wood can be used as firing fuel or to create new structures.

Buy a lorry at your home base, collect all wood and a chunk of ore and create a piece of metal in the foundry.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Gold Mine
scenarios.description:
Gold Mine

Using the construction kit from the home base, build a new elevator.

Create an elevator shaft and a tunnel down to the vein of gold.

Chunks of gold need to be blasted free with flintstones. They can be sold in the home base.

Further details on construction and elevator control are located in the help system.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Underground
scenarios.description:
Underground

Your objective is to retrieve a single crystal chunk and sell it at your home base.

Unfortunately, the area is not completely earthquake-safe.

With the material available in this round, you can build an elevator. The elevator will require energy supply which can be created with the power plant by burning coal.

Getting the layer of water out of your way might require some thought.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Acid Lake
scenarios.description:
Acid Lake

Another crystal chunk has to be retrieved and taken to the home base.

To get across the lake you need to build a new hot air balloon in the workshop (command 'up'). This will require construction material which can be bought in your home base (command 'up').

The money you need to buy new material can be obtained by selling gold.

To get back from the other side of the lake, carefully get on the sailboat, grab it and control it with commands 'left' and 'right'.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Wipf Rescue
scenarios.description:
Save The Wipfs

The furry little creatures enjoy running and jumping around the place.

Your objective is to catch all wipfs by hand or using the lorry. Take them to your home base and sell them.

Landscape.Layers: Rock-Rough=20; Tunnel-Smooth=70; Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Arctic Ocean
scenarios.description:
Arctic Ocean

Hardy clonks settle even here.

Build an igloo and gain 50 points by selling fish that you catch in the sea.

Landscape.Layers: Rock-Rough=20; Tunnel-Smooth=70; Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Volcanic
scenarios.description:
Volcanic World

In this hostile environment, gain 150 points wealth by mining.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Granite=3; Gold=7; Ore=5; Sulphur-Swirl=7; Ashes-Smooth3=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Settlement
scenarios.description:
Settlement

Through simple mouse clicks you can make your clonks collect items or create structures.

Build a hut, a windmill, and a sawmill to found a new settlement.

In this round, you also need to produce some wood for additional buildings by cutting down trees.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Goldmine
scenarios.description:
Goldmine

Gold has been discovered right by your new settlement.

Build an elevator to create a mine shaft.

Use flintstones to blast free some chunks of gold that you can carry to your homebase.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Production
scenarios.description:
Production

In the foundry, mined ore and coal can be turned to metal that you will need to build a workshop and a hot air balloon.

With the balloon you can reach the top of the nearby cliff at which a hidden treasure can be found.

Landscape.Layers: Earth-Rough=100; Earth-Smooth2=100;

scenarios.title: Acid World
scenarios.description:
Acid World

Not a very nice region. It's raining a green acid here, which can be sold when filled in barrels.

Also this world is the home of the green monsters. Any clonks standing in their way will be overrun by them.

In the earth you can find monster eggs. Thrown on the ground, a little monster breaks out of the white hull and quickly grows to a big hazard.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Granite=5; Gold=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Ore=3; Sulphur-Swirl=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Arctic Ocean
scenarios.description:
Arctic Ocean

Probably one of the most desolate worlds.

Building up a flourishing settlement in this environment does not only require technical skill but also a certain level of inventiveness.

Beware of water freezing over. There have been a number of clonks reported suffocated stuck in the ice.

scenarios.title: Desert
scenarios.description:
Desert

Bone dry.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Magic
scenarios.description:
Magic World

As temperate climate, but with crystal underground resources, which can be converted into magical energy.

The wizard tower will convert crystals and lightning strikes to magic energy. Any clonk can control the wizard tower from the inside ('left' and 'right' for direction, 'up' to cast a spell).

Also in this world, magic clonks can be bought at the home base, which will then permanently join a player's crew. Magic clonks can reload energy in the wizard tower and are able to cast spells even when moving around by control 'double dig'.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Crystal-Flare=8; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50;

scenarios.title: Sky Islands
scenarios.description:
Sky Islands

Each player is based on an island floating in mid air.

Any wrong step can mean inevitable death. So be careful when mining for resources.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=5; Ore=3; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Temperate Climate
scenarios.description:
Temperate Climate

The world most known to clonks.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Tropical Island
scenarios.description:
Tropical Islands

Stranded on a far beach, with just enough construction material for a bamboo hut.

scenarios.title: Volcanic
scenarios.description:
Volcanic World

Lava pours out from smouldering crevices, layers of sulphur can be found underground.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Granite=5; Gold=5; Ore=3; Sulphur-Swirl=5; Ashes-Smooth3=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.title: Arctic
scenarios.description:
Arctic

This is the home of the Inuit clonks, a people skilled in survival in this barren environment.

Most of their time the Inuit spend hunting and fishing, thus gathering food and materials needed to produce tools and all necessary equipment.

But beware, at those freezing temperatures nobody can survive long without shelter. Only with warm clothing the Inuk can travel outdoors for a length of time before he has to return to his warm igloo.

On extensive journeys the most important pieces of equipment, such as mallet, knife, harpoon, and if possible a life amulet should be carried along. A leather sack is very helpful here.

Population will increase whenever some members of the tribe stay home for a while, with enough food and enough living space. Normal igloos, however, are already fully occupied with two inhabitants.

Through the power of magical amulets an Inuk may become an Angakok, able to communicate with the spirits of nature.

Daylight will be long in summer, followed by permanent darkness in winter.

scenarios.title: Deep Sea
scenarios.description:
Deep Sea

Some fearless clonk pioneers have settled even the oceans all over the globe in the last few centuries. Within the time, their whole life has been adapted on their new environment; their body supports the high pressure in the depths and their lungs can hold much more than these of their land-born neighbours.

Some other habitudes have changed as well: Most structures are built out of the ore found in deep undersea mines or out of the corals that can be found almost anywhere. The nutritious fishes are prepared in many variations. The sea has got an advantage for the transport of heavy weights and clonks.

Nevertheless, you will have to keep an eye on your resources: Most things have to be built by yourself and only the construction of residential units provides the place for further habitants of your settlement.

scenarios.title: Jungle
scenarios.description:
Jungle

The inhabitants of the amaclonkian forests make a living far from civilization. They developed the art of throwing a spear and fishing their favorite food, the piranha. The fireplace in the center of the village allows to prepare a delicious meal out of all jungle livings.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Fleckig=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

publisherContestEvidence.scope: Original contest rules state selected entries appear on the RedWolf site. They do not grant third-party redistribution.

officialWesternEvidence.scope: Official pack distinguishes authorized incorporated contest objects from objects completely rewritten for the official release.

restrictedUses.restriction: Author asks permission for using/modifying objects, particularly rendered graphics.
restrictedUses.scope: Object reuse/adaptation; not treated as an express prohibition on unchanged archive redistribution.

restrictedUses.restriction: Author asks prior permission for using listed new spells and non-original object overrides; author files must remain.
restrictedUses.scope: Object reuse/adaptation; unchanged archive redistribution grant remains unresolved.

limitedGrants.scope: Permits modification and distribution of this one clonk, including own scenarios; does not license entire Artificial archive.
